author: CFA Nova helper / sw2_result_technical_review
scope: Refresh only CFA main remote evidence and its relation to local HEAD; no fetch, checkout, reset, merge, commit, push or source mutations.
reason: The later local metadata already recorded an updated origin/main and update-by-push reflog while local main HEAD remained old. The first remote checkpoint predates that concurrent push and cannot establish a current match.

committedDifference.scope: Committed trees differ. Matching names alone do not prove current untracked/ignored file bytes match remote blobs.

currentTrackedChangesComparisonToRemote.method: Git diff of current working-tree versions against the locally available freshly advertised remote commit, restricted to non-sensitive tracked changed paths. Only status/path metadata is displayed.

latestObservedLocalPushLog.limit: This is actual local tracking-ref reflog evidence of an update by push. The audit does not identify the human/process/worktree author or guarantee no later push elsewhere.

interpretation.workingTreeVersionsMustBeConsideredSepar: A behind local branch does not automatically mean every changed local file lacks remote coverage; the restricted Git comparison above records which tracked current versions differ. Untracked/ignored media and Drive coverage remain separate evidence.
